homograph.note: The noun (a description of events) and the verb phrase "account for" (to explain, or to make up a share of a total) are far enough apart that a learner who knows one will not guess the other; the bank-account sense is a third, separate reading. A hint must say which sense it targets.

senses.definition: a written or spoken description of something that has happened

examples.en: Her account of the accident differed sharply from the driver's.
examples.fa: روایت او از آن تصادف به‌شدت با روایت راننده تفاوت داشت.

senses.definition: used in "account for" — to explain the cause of something, or to form a particular part of a total

examples.en: Oil accounts for almost half of the country's export income.
examples.fa: نفت تقریباً نیمی از درآمد صادراتی آن کشور را تشکیل می‌دهد.
